title: Diving: the greats overview
d: The greatest Diving players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
definition: The greatest Diving players, ranked by titles, records, and influence.
description: The pantheon of Diving is argued in every bar and barbershop, but the names in this database appear on every serious list: champions who won the biggest prizes, record-setters whose numbers still stand, and pioneers who changed how Diving is played. Greatness here is measured three ways — winning, statistics, and influence — and the truest greats score on all three. Study them not to worship but to learn: every great was once a beginner who mastered fundamentals.

title: Greg Louganis
description: Greg Louganis competed at the top of Diving from 1978-1988, and the achievement that defines the career is this: Double-double golds (1984, 1988). What separated Greg Louganis was not one skill but the complete package — technique hardened by repetition, tactics sharpened by study, and the temperament to deliver when everything is on the line. Young players should study not just the highlights but the habits: the training volume, the professionalism, and the longevity that turned talent into legacy.
